vb_textbox.text: You need to look at the shades of the gnomes. You will see two gnomes and find one will be darker in colour and one lighter. The amount of mushrooms corresponds to the light / dark colour. So for a period you will find the darker coloured gnome will collect more mushrooms and then this number will start to drop and the lighter colour gnome will begin to collect more and so you should then begin picking the lighter gnome. At times both gnomes will only collect a small amount of mushrooms and then one shade will begin to collect more again. Essentially you want to stick with shade (lighter or darker) that is picking the most mushrooms until the number drops then switch it up. I found the max number of mushrooms collected at once is 9.
